notes.text:
Polysomnography Report
Date: 01/24/2026
Patient: Vertie Rutherford, 70 y/o F

Attended PSG 01/24/2026. Study revealed severe sleep-disordered breathing. Total sleep time 360 min, sleep efficiency 85%. Sleep stages: N1 10%, N2 50%, N3 15%, REM 25%. AHI 50.5/h. CA+MA 14% of total AHI. Oxygen desaturation nadir 78%, mean SpO2 92%. Periodic limb movements index 5/h. No significant arrhythmias noted. 

Impression: Severe obstructive sleep apnea with mixed apneas. Recommend evaluation for CPAP therapy initiation.
